messages.content: "你能幫我創作一首D小調、每分鐘120拍的音樂，然後產生一個頻率為440赫茲、振幅為0.5的音訊訊號嗎？之後，我想要創作另一首E大調、每分鐘90拍、拍子記號為3/4的音樂。最後，產生另一個頻率為300赫茲、振幅為0.7、持續5秒的音訊訊號。"

function.name: audio_generate
function.description: Generate an audio signal given a frequency, amplitude, and duration. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

frequency.description: Frequency of the audio signal in Hz.

amplitude.description: Amplitude of the audio signal. This is a float type value.

duration.description: Duration of the audio signal in seconds. Default is 1 second if not specified. This is a float type value.

function.name: music_generate
function.description: Generate a piece of music given a key, tempo, and time signature. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

key.description: The key of the piece, e.g., C Major.

tempo.description: Tempo of the piece in beats per minute.

time_signature.description: Time signature of the piece, e.g., 4/4. Default is '4/4' if not specified.

message.reasoning:
The user wants us to do two things:

1. Create a piece of music with key D minor, tempo 120 bpm, default time signature (likely 4/4). Then generate an audio signal at 440Hz, amplitude 0.5.

2. Create another piece of music with key E major, tempo 90 bpm, time signature 3/4.

3. Finally, produce an audio signal at 300Hz, amplitude 0.7, duration 5 seconds.

We have two functions: music_generate and audio_generate. We need to call them accordingly.

We should call music_generate twice: first with key "D Minor", tempo 120; second with key "E Major", tempo 90, time_signature "3/4".

Then we need to call audio_generate three times: first with frequency 440, amplitude 0.5; second with frequency 300, amplitude 0.7, duration 5.

But the user says "產生一個頻率為440赫茲、振幅為0.5的音訊訊號" after the first music generation. So we need to call audio_generate after each music generation? Actually they want to create a piece of music then produce an audio signal. Then create another piece of music. Then produce another audio signal. So we need to call audio_generate twice: one after the first music generation, one after the second music generation? Wait, the last part says "最後，產生另一個頻率為300赫茲、振幅為0.7、持續5秒的音訊訊號." That is separate from the second music generation. They didn't specify to produce an audio signal after the second music generation. But maybe they want to produce an audio signal after each music generation. Let's interpret as: After generating the first music, produce an audio signal at 440Hz, amplitude 0.5. Then generate the second music. Then produce an audio signal at 300Hz, amplitude 0.7, duration 5s. So we need to call audio_generate twice: first with freq=440, amp=0.5, default duration 1 sec; second with freq=300, amp=0.7, duration=5.

Thus we will call music_generate twice and audio_generate twice. We'll output the results. Use the tool calls.
